overview_description.description: Protect4Less (P4L) is an insurtech company that provides device protection and extended warranty plans for consumer electronics and home appliances. The platform allows customers to subscribe to affordable protection plans that cover accidental damage, mechanical failures, and theft for devices such as smartphones, laptops, tablets, TVs, and other household electronics.

about_short_description.short_description: Protect4less is an insurtech company that provides device protection and extended warranty plans.

product.name: Protect4Less Device Protection Plan
product.description: A subscription-based protection plan covering accidental damage, theft by forced entry, and extended warranty for mobile phones and electronic devices.

product.name: Protect4Less Extended Warranty
product.description: An extended warranty service covering mechanical and electrical failures beyond the standard manufacturer warranty for electronic devices.

product.name: Protect4Less Accidental Damage Coverage
product.description: Coverage for accidental damage including cracked screens, back glass, and liquid damage for electronic devices under subscription plans.

product.name: Protect4Less Theft Protection
product.description: Theft protection covering loss of devices due to forced entry for devices under subscription plans.

product.name: Protect4Less Partner Program
product.description: A program enabling retailers and partners to sell Protect4Less protection plans and earn commissions on sales.
